title: V1 release-gate rerun after B-01/B-02/B-03/B-04/B-07

commands.name: playwright
commands.command: PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 pnpm exec playwright test --workers=4

securityChecks.accountAudit: login/logout, key changes, exports, deletion, generation and fact decisions
securityChecks.accountExport: complete ZIP with signed download, 7-day expiry and author isolation
securityChecks.accountLifecycle: password reset/change, email change, pen names, deletion/recovery/purge
securityChecks.workLifecycle: import, archive, soft delete/recover, copy, completed read-only and purge
securityChecks.signedDownloads: short-lived HMAC tokens with path redaction
securityChecks.backupRestore: Postgres and object-store restore drill passed

dependencyResidualRisk.exposure: bucket notification parser is not called by the product

externalGates: B-05 human quality and reader blind review
B-07 real DNS/ACME/KMS/SMTP/central logging/offsite disaster-recovery evidence
